summary: Completed the first full primary-source review of ROBOTIS Co., Ltd. common shares, established its immutable KOSDAQ/KRW identity, recorded a scenario-complete assessment, and published the company research page and catalog entry. ROBOTIS has direct actuator and humanoid-product exposure, strong liquidity, and improving underlying operations, but the KRW254,500 market price implies an extreme premium to the evidence available. The deterministic assessment is Strong Sell / Avoid, allocation ineligible, with no strategy, signal, order, or paper trade. Separate bounded relationship and idea reviews were queued so the robotics edge can be accepted or rejected independently.

evidence.claim: DART identifies ROBOTIS as a Korean special-purpose-machinery issuer listed on KOSDAQ under code 108490.
The statutory first-half 2026 income statement reports KRW27.213 billion revenue, KRW9.862 billion operating loss, and a profitable second quarter with KRW1.981 billion operating profit.
The statutory balance sheet supports approximately KRW281.3 billion of simple net financial assets against KRW10.966 billion total liabilities at 30 June 2026.

Actuators supplied 97.99% of first-half revenue, with the X series accounting for about 90% of actuator sales; Q-series and AI Sapiens commercialization remain forward-looking plans rather than disclosed material humanoid revenue.
The canonical market state records 108490.KQ at KRW254,500 and KRW/EUR at 0.0006282000103965402, both retrieved at 2026-09-01T06:49:13Z.

The validated scenario assessment calculates KRW20,625 bear, KRW70,968 base, KRW282,667 bull, and KRW98,204.9 probability-weighted fair value, producing the canonical Strong Sell / Avoid disposition and no allocation eligibility.
